captions.detailed: A tall, narrow tower-style box fan featuring a light gray square-column housing. It is mounted on a circular base with a stepped profile, connected by a dark gray pivot collar. A dark, slotted vertical grille runs down one side of the column, and a single black rotary control knob sits on a small cylindrical boss at the very top. The column is designed to oscillate horizontally relative to the fixed base, and the top control knob rotates to adjust fan speed.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tall tower fan with a light gray rectangular column housing, a black vertical front grille, and a stepped circular base. Include a dark gray pivot collar connecting the base to the column to allow horizontal oscillation, and a small black rotary knob at the top of the column.
captions.factory: The model is built using four main parts: a base, a pivot, a tower, and a knob. The base is constructed by fusing two concentric cylinders of different radii to form a stepped circular foot. The pivot is a small cylinder centered on the base. The main tower is created as a tall box with a smaller box subtracted from one face to form the recessed vertical grille. A small cylinder is added on top of the tower to serve as the knob boss, and the knob itself is modeled as a small black cylinder. Revolute joints are modeled between the base and pivot (for oscillation) and between the tower top and the speed knob.
